summary: Iteration 3 verification run (backend + frontend). Regression extras: /api/tools/python print(6*7) -> '42', suite bot_count sums to exactly 150 and each suite filter returns the matching count, non-admin gets 403 on /admin/bots, /admin/overview, /admin/import, admin bcrypt hash is $2b$, wrong password rejected, multi-user authz (conversations/memory/favorites/file-download ownership) and live persona/isolation + prompt-injection tests all pass. No new defects found.
